proposals.title: Management Pay Clawback Authorization
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to defer a substantial portion of executive officers' annual pay for at least three years and forfeit it to help satisfy any monetary penalty for violations of law, regardless of individual responsibility.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends a vote AGAINST this Proposal 5.

proposals.title: Independent Board Chairman
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to adopt a policy requiring separation of the Chairman and CEO roles, with the Chairman being an independent director who is not a former CEO.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends a vote AGAINST this Proposal 6.

proposals.title: not stated
proposals.proponent: The Sisters of St. Joseph, Missionary Oblates of Mary Immaculate, Monasterio Pan de Vida, and The Sisters of St. Francis of Philadelphia
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report assessing how effective Citi's policies and practices are in respecting internationally recognized human rights standards for Indigenous Peoples' rights in its financing.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this Proposal 7.

proposals.title: Ending New Fossil Fuel Financing
proposals.proponent: Harrington Investments, Inc. and Boston Common Asset Management
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to adopt a policy by end of 2022 ensuring lending and underwriting do not contribute to new fossil fuel supplies inconsistent with IEA Net Zero 2050 pathway.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends a vote AGAINST this Proposal 8.

proposals.title: Civil Rights and Non-Discrimination Audit Proposal
proposals.proponent: National Center for Public Policy Research
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to commission a non-discrimination audit analyzing the Company's impacts on civil rights and non-discrimination for all Americans, with a publicly disclosed report.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends a vote AGAINST this Proposal 9.
